scientific_integrity: Analytic proof reconstructs sections and integrates surface patches; finite independent geometry computations corroborate but do not prove general case. No independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Equal radii and common center/diameter are required; no claim for displaced circles, unequal radii or noncircular sections. Special case of orthogonal unit disk pair is known from Finch 2012. Earlier unindexed derivations remain a priority risk.
title: A universal surface–volume identity for hulls of concurrent circular disks
